businesses.business: cloud business phone and communications services

offering_description.value: Provides cloud-based phone, video and messaging services (UCaaS) to small and mid-sized businesses, plus residential VoIP calling. Sells subscriptions with supporting hardware such as IP phones and adapters, and also offers managed networking and SD-WAN services delivered via its cloud platform.

primary_products.value: IP desk phones and adapters; VoIP telephony devices; SD-WAN and networking appliances

primary_services.value: cloud business phone service; video and messaging; residential VoIP calling; managed networking and SD-WAN; virtual receptionist and contact center

customer_segment.value: B2B: small and mid-sized businesses, multi-location enterprises, and channel partners; B2C: residential households using home VoIP phone service

end_markets.value: small business communications; professional services; healthcare; retail; residential telephony

revenue_model.value: subscription: monthly recurring fees for cloud phone, video, and managed network services; product sales: IP phones, adapters and networking devices; transaction or usage fees: international calling and usage charges
revenue_model.category: subscription; product sales; transaction or usage fees

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: operates cloud communications platform, selling subscriptions to businesses and consumers; brand owner: designs branded phones and devices made by contract manufacturers, sold to customers; service provider: provides telephony and managed network services using carrier interconnections
value_chain_position.category: software / platform; brand owner; service provider

geography_served.value: North America: US and Canada primarily, with international calling and some presence in other countries

specialization.value: related lines: business cloud phone, residential VoIP, and managed networking/connectivity services

distribution_channels.value: online: direct website sales and self-service sign-up; direct sales: inside sales teams for businesses; partners / resellers: channel partners, agents and resellers; third-party retail: retail and online marketplaces for residential devices
distribution_channels.category: online; direct sales; partners / resellers; third-party retail

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: VoIP telecom rules: FCC, CRTC, E911, universal service fees, robocall (STIR/SHAKEN), state telecom regulation, data privacy

notes: Recent product mix (e.g., networking/SD-WAN and AirDial additions) may not be fully captured; details are approximate.
